description: This file provides functions for interacting with Google Chat API, including sending, updating, deleting messages, uploading/downloading media, managing reactions, and probing the API.

methods.name: withGoogleChatResponse
methods.description: Handles API response, including error handling and response processing.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from Google Chat API with proper headers and response handling.

methods.name: fetchOk
methods.description: Performs a fetch request expecting no return data, mainly for delete or update operations.

methods.name: fetchBuffer
methods.description: Fetches binary media data from Google Chat API, with optional max byte size enforcement.
